name: DesignCraft
tagline: Page layout and publishing, rebuilt in pure Rust
blurb: Spreads and parent pages, threaded stories, styles, swatches and text wrap in a native layout app with a professional paragraph composer.
description:
DesignCraft is built for publishing books, magazines, brochures and print layouts.

Features master pages, baseline grids, CMYK swatches, OpenType font features, optical margin alignment, and print-ready PDF/X export.

install.label: Cargo / Build from source
install.command: git clone https://github.com/storytold/designcraft.git && cd designcraft && cargo run --release
